summary: Approved as a conditional theorem. The original-coordinate simplex and fiber-volume normalization, finite complete integer support, coloring energy minimum and full minimizing-face dimension, common-budget Laplace comparison with both powers, factorial estimates, and tree-block composition are correct, including the smallest permitted tree, both root-color cases, and empty or nonempty remainders. The finite-grid reduction retains all integer bases and all grid flows in its upper bound; its truncated lower bound uses complete disjoint cells, its recurrences count every true edge once, and q^378 accounts exactly for the two cell-comparison errors. The supplied accepted actual-body theorem applies at the fixed positive coloring center and cutoff zero, giving the stated point before all closed ambient halfspaces. Inequalities (4) and (8) are not claimed proved: the packet correctly proves (4) implies the stated volume and depth bounds and (8) implies (4).
